logp.method_description: Lipophilicity of 1–3 has been determined by the “shake flask” method using octanol/water phase partitions.94–96 Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water saturated octanol (WSO) were prepared using analytical grade octanol (Merck) and double distilled water. Complexes 1–3 (1 mg mL-1; ethanol–water 1 : 6) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg mL-1 in water alternatively and these (1 mg mL-1) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg mL-1 in octanol, respectively. Appropriate amounts of complexes (4 mg mL-1) were shaken for 24 h at rt in an equal volume (50 : 50). After attainment of equilibrium organic and aqueous phases were separated and centrifuged. Finally, the concentration of the drug in each phase was determined by UV/vis spectroscopy. The sample solution concentration was used to calculate log P and partition coefficients for 1–3 calculated using the equation log P = log[(1–3)oct/(1–3)aq].96
